info.title: OpenMic v1 External API
info.description: API specification for OpenMic v1 External API, providing endpoints for bot management, call handling, and phone number operations.

tags.name: Calls

tags.name: Voices
tags.description: Endpoints for browsing available text-to-speech voices. Voices are read-only and can be filtered by gender, provider, language, and accent.

ToolType.description: The type of tool that determines its behavior and required configuration.

CreateToolRequest.description: Create a tool for a bot. Each tool type has different required fields and `static_params` structure. See the `x-tool-examples` section for complete examples of each type.

description.description: Description of what the tool does. This is shown to the AI to help it decide when to use the tool.

method.description: HTTP method for API requests. Defaults to `get`.

parameters.description: JSON schema defining the tool's input parameters. The AI will extract these from the conversation.

use_raw_schema.description: If true, `parameters` is used as-is without transformation. This setting takes precedence over the type-derived default. Set to `true` for `function` type tools.

static_params.description: Static configuration that varies by tool type. See examples below for each type's schema.

speak_during_execution.description: If true, bot speaks a filler message while tool executes.

speak_after_execution.description: If true, bot announces the result after execution.

async.description: If true, tool runs asynchronously without blocking the conversation.

x-tool-examples.title: api_request - Make HTTP requests to external APIs
x-tool-examples.description: Use this to call external REST APIs. The bot extracts parameters from the conversation and sends them to your endpoint. **Required: `url`**

value.name: get_order_status
value.description: Look up the status of a customer order by order ID

order_id.description: The order ID to look up

x-tool-examples.title: function - Custom function with raw JSON schema
x-tool-examples.description: Use this when you need full control over the function schema. **Required: `use_raw_schema: true`, `parameters`**

value.name: calculate_quote
value.description: Calculate a price quote based on customer requirements

x-tool-examples.title: end_call - Terminate the current call
x-tool-examples.description: Ends the call gracefully with an optional goodbye message. **static_params: `{ end_message: string }`**

value.name: end_call
value.description: End the call when the customer says goodbye or the conversation is complete

x-tool-examples.title: transfer_call - Transfer the call to another number
x-tool-examples.description: Transfers the call to a specified phone number. **static_params: `{ routing_rules, default_transfer_number, transfer_type }`**

value.name: transfer_to_sales
value.description: Transfer the call to the sales team when customer wants to make a purchase

static_params.routing_rules: When customer wants to buy or make a purchase, transfer to +15551234567

x-tool-examples.title: dtmf - Send DTMF tones (keypad presses)
x-tool-examples.description: Sends touch-tone digits during the call, useful for IVR navigation. **static_params: `{ digits: string }`**

value.name: press_digits
value.description: Press keypad digits when navigating phone menus

x-tool-examples.title: send_sms - Send an SMS message
x-tool-examples.description: Sends a text message to a phone number during the call. **static_params: `{ message: string }`**

value.name: send_confirmation_sms
value.description: Send appointment confirmation via SMS when customer books

static_params.message: Your appointment has been confirmed for {{appointment_date}} at {{appointment_time}}. Reply CANCEL to cancel.

x-tool-examples.title: send_email - Send an email
x-tool-examples.description: Sends an email during the call. **static_params: `{ to, subject, body }`**

value.name: send_quote_email
value.description: Email a price quote to the customer

static_params.subject: Your Price Quote from Acme Corp
static_params.body: Thank you for your interest. Your quote for {{service_type}} is ${{quote_amount}}.

x-tool-examples.title: call_booking - Book a calendar appointment
x-tool-examples.description: Creates a booking in an integrated calendar system (e.g., Clio, Zoho). **static_params: `{ calendar_integration, duration_minutes }`**

value.name: book_appointment
value.description: Book an appointment when customer requests to schedule a meeting

x-tool-examples.title: check_calendar_availability - Check available time slots
x-tool-examples.description: Queries the calendar system for available appointment slots. **static_params: `{ calendar_integration, days_ahead }`**

value.name: check_availability
value.description: Check available appointment times when customer asks about availability

x-tool-examples.title: check_working_hours - Check if within business hours
x-tool-examples.description: Determines if the current time is within configured working hours. Useful for routing after-hours calls. **static_params: `{ timezone, working_hours }`**

value.name: check_business_hours
value.description: Check if calling during business hours to route appropriately
